temperature_source: Use exact supplier/printer profile; broad dataset range is not a final setting.
notes: Place the supplied large side face on the build plate; the hinge axis is vertical.
Print the combined hinge/latch coupon first with the exact same PETG and profile.
Inspect both 0.40 mm axial gaps, the 0.35 mm radial gap, 0.80 mm armor grooves, latch tongue, and 0.40 mm recessed mark layer by layer.
Start without generated supports; use a 3-5 mm brim only if side-face adhesion is unreliable.
Retain the 3MF project/profile identity for the exact machine/material/nozzle combination.
